name: helper_background_sequence
methodology: Exact raw LSL source extracted unchanged from the two existing native unit sequences. Actual original CodeGen, base CheckRunWork, StartEx and ResumeEx are driven directly. External posts use unchanged PostEvent while the harness owns RUNNING execution; the sleep-until field is cleared at scheduler handoff to avoid absent worker-thread wake. No backend, handler, migration or queue methods are replaced. Actual private production MigrateOutEventHandler plus detector/queue XML envelopes are captured and restored. Each genuine wait/sleep boundary records exact frames, globals, arguments and detectors; live and migrated resume sequences are independent. The explicit UTF8 writer is a separate control, not the production route.
